newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sen. Lott says budget deal "much closer".
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sen. Lott says budget deal "much closer".

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott said Wednesday evening talks with the White House have pushed prospects of a budget agreement "much closer" and that talks will continue.
Republicans huddled during the day to mull over proposals exchanged with the White House on spending cuts needed to reach a balanced budget by the year 2002 and on tax cuts sought by both sides.
"The tempo has increased signficantly. We are much closer to getting agreement on a balanced budget...We are not there yet. There are gaps in a couple of critical areas," he said.
